Atmosphere
Physical observations / 15–29 October 2026
Land outlines above data; no land fill. Missing observations are not zero.
World dataset: JAXA/EORC observations; NASA MODIS shortwave input.

Cloud retrievals are regional and daytime only. AOD is not smoke or PM2.5.
Cartographic image width: 43.5 inches on a 44-inch sheet; artwork scaled proportionally to 98.863636%.
Japan detail includes neighboring countries; it is not a Japan-only total.
Yellow point: conceptual Setouchi reference (34.45°N, 133.99°E); venue unconfirmed.
Radiation opacity · 100 bands
Stronger cells are more opaque; the same scale applies to both views.
Low values fade to transparent. Missing observations are not zero.

a.text: 01 Hajime Narukawa — AuthaGraph formulation
2022 formulation; native Cartofreako implementation
Projection and graticules are mathematical constructions. Horizontal periodicity supports the ST2 framing study.
https://doi.org/10.11212/jjca.60.1_1
02 Natural Earth — 1:10m physical vectors
Pinned local vectors used by the 29 October 2026 delivery; not new observations
Land, coastline, minor islands, lakes, rivers, ice and generalized bathymetry. Individual version files and component
hashes are in the JSON ledger.
https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-physical-vectors/
Attribution / use: Public domain

g.text: Measure and interpretation
Physical observations / 15–29 October 2026
H3 resolution 5; per-layer quality masks and valid-sample threshold retained. Source times differ. Solar geometry is
calculated at 29 October 2026, 20:00 UTC. Land fill opacity zero, outlines above data.
Japan companion
Same evidence in the Japan/Setouchi geographic viewport; neighboring countries may appear. No island-level value
is inferred. The nighttime snapshot contains no positive daytime cloud retrievals; missing cloud is not clear sky.

a.text: Source ledger
Pinned input files, complete source manifests and checksums:
https://bdekoz.github.io/cartofreako/docs/pages/gallery/setouchi-2028-bibliography.json

g.text: H3r5 selected edition · original observation dates and sampling retained
Actual H3 cell boundaries; original source-center values reaggregated directly at this resolution.
Unoccupied cells have no sampled center: unobserved, not zero. Source-pixel footprints are not filled.
Finer indexing adds no observations. Data layers render at 300 dpi; PDF embeds them. Outlines and type remain vector.
Atmosphere: maximum 720 samples per raster axis, quality masks retained; radiation uses the same 100 opacity levels.
